text: The changed Panorama blocks each contain three direct assertions without a message: folder-bridge existence, root path ID and child ID array. All six changed sites need a nonempty expected-behavior message under the deliberate review requirement. This is separate from the preference for the word should and does not make unrelated older assertions part of the change. The accepted snippets retain these missing arguments; no test was executed or source fixed.
title: The changed server-preference database assertions omit expected-behavior messages
